worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.summary: Unleash a sphere of aura that curves after the target: this attack never misses. Distant guidance reaches further and turns harder; the direct blast is thicker, faster and heavier with a shorter range.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.use.0: Call out a target at long range
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.use.1: Hunt a target that keeps moving and backing off
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.use.2: Pin mid-range with one dense sphere
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.description: Deal %1$s Fighting special damage. This attack never misses.
Range %1$s blocks, sphere speed %2$s blocks/tick, turning up to %3$s degrees per tick toward the target.
The sphere can hold a target within %1$s blocks, so it cannot be shaken off once launched.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.seek.on: Distant guidance: longer range and harder turning, at the cost of a little power, sphere speed, and longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.seek.off: Direct blast: a thicker, faster, heavier sphere, at the cost of a shorter range.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.growth.0: From level %1$s the sphere rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.aurasphere.growth.1: From level %1$s the sphere rises to %2$s power and %3$s degrees/tick turning.
On (seek): range x1.18, turning x1.3, so it holds targets further out, but power x0.92, speed x0.9, +2 ticks wind-up and +5 ticks cooldown. Off (smash): a thicker, faster, heavier sphere with a shorter range.
